insights.one_liner: DSV is a Danish road, sea and air logistics company with mid-level data and finance roles in Venlo and 's-Heerenberg.

culture.text: A Danish transport and logistics company moving goods by road, sea and air.
Current Dutch roles are in Venlo and 's-Heerenberg rather than the big cities.

open.text: This entity is not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor.
One of its two current jobs here doesn't require Dutch.

growth.text: Signed a 1 million sq ft industrial lease in Denton, US.

worth_knowing.text: Its roles draw a lot of interest, averaging 122 applicants each on LinkedIn.
